questions.text_en: Does the child make sounds like "a" "ba" and "ga"?

questions.text_en: When you place the child on the ground, does he use his hands as a support? (If before that he sits straight without leaning on his hands, you should mark the answer yes)

questions.text_en: Does the child use both hands at the same time? If not, explain.

questions.text_fa: آيا سابقه ناشنوايي و يا مشكلات شنوايي در دوران كودكي اعضاي خانواده هر يك از والدين وجود دارد ؟ اگر بله توضيح دهيد .

questions.text_fa: آيا در مورد كودك خود نگراني خاصي داريد ؟اگر بله توضيح دهيد .
questions.text_en: Do you have any special concerns about your child? If yes, explain.
